channel.title: PowerRun Industries Product Feed
channel.description: Lithium batteries, hybrid solar inverters and solar panels.

item.title: PR Hybrid Inverter 3.6kW
item.description: The PowerRun 3.6kW Hybrid Solar Inverter delivers a rated output of 3,600W (7,200VA peak) from a 24V battery bank, with a built-in MPPT solar charge controller accepting up to 5,000W of PV input. It switches seamlessly between grid, solar and battery power in as little as 10ms, delivering clean 230V pure sine wave output for sensitive electronics. With up to 98% conversion efficiency and LCD + WiFi monitoring, it is built for reliable day-to-day backup in homes and small businesses, backed by a 5-year warranty.

item.title: PR Hybrid Inverter 4.2kW
item.description: The PowerRun 4.2kW Hybrid Solar Inverter is rated for 4,200W (8,400VA peak) output from a 24V battery bank, with a built-in MPPT controller supporting up to 6,000W of solar panel input. It automatically transfers between grid, solar and battery in 10ms, producing stable 230V pure sine wave power for homes and small offices that need a bit more headroom than the 3.6kW model. Up to 98% efficiency, LCD + WiFi monitoring, and a 5-year warranty come standard.

item.title: PR Hybrid Inverter 6.2kW
item.description: The PowerRun 6.2kW Hybrid Solar Inverter runs on a 48V battery bank and delivers 6,200W (12,400VA peak) of clean 230V pure sine wave power, with a built-in MPPT controller handling up to 8,500W of solar input. Designed for larger homes and small commercial setups, it switches between grid, solar and battery in 10ms and reaches up to 98% efficiency, with LCD + WiFi monitoring and a 5-year warranty.

item.title: PR Hybrid Inverter 8.2kW
item.description: The PowerRun 8.2kW Hybrid Solar Inverter is built for commercial and larger residential installations, delivering 8,200W (16,400VA peak) from a 48V battery bank. Its dual MPPT solar charge controller accepts up to 2 x 5,500W of PV input across two independent strings, and multiple units can run in parallel for higher-capacity systems. With up to 98% efficiency, 230V pure sine wave output, LCD + WiFi monitoring and a 5-year warranty, it is engineered for demanding daily use.

item.title: PR Hybrid Inverter 11kW
item.description: The PowerRun 11kW Hybrid Solar Inverter delivers a rated 11,000W (up to 12,000W dual-output, 24,000VA peak) from a 48V battery bank, making it suited to larger homes, offices and light commercial loads. Dual MPPT tracking supports up to 2 x 8,500W of solar input, and the inverter supports parallel operation and grid-tie connection for scaling up capacity. Up to 98% efficiency, 230V pure sine wave output, LCD + WiFi monitoring and a 5-year warranty are standard.

item.title: PR Hybrid Inverter 12kW
item.description: The PowerRun 12kW Hybrid Solar Inverter is built for commercial-scale backup, delivering up to 12,000W of dual output power (11,000W rated, 24,000VA peak) from a 48V battery bank. Dual MPPT solar charge controllers handle up to 2 x 8,500W of PV input, with parallel operation and grid-tie support for multi-unit installations. It provides 230V pure sine wave output at up to 98% efficiency, with LCD + WiFi monitoring and a 5-year warranty.

item.title: PR LFP Battery 25.6V 100Ah
item.description: The PowerRun 25.6V 100Ah LiFePO4 battery stores 2.56kWh of usable energy in a safe, long-life lithium iron phosphate cell chemistry. An integrated Smart BMS protects against over-charge, over-discharge and short circuit, while the cell design supports 6000+ charge cycles at 80% depth of discharge, far outlasting a comparable lead-acid battery. It is built for small home backup, solar storage and off-grid setups where reliable, low-maintenance power matters, and is backed by a 5-year warranty.

item.title: PR LFP Battery 25.6V 200Ah
item.description: The PowerRun 25.6V 200Ah LiFePO4 battery delivers 5.12kWh of usable energy storage with an integrated Smart BMS guarding against over-charge, over-discharge and short circuit. Rated for 6000+ cycles at 80% depth of discharge, it is built to outlast lead-acid alternatives by several times over, making it a solid choice for home backup and small solar systems. Comes with a 5-year warranty.

item.title: PR LFP Battery 25.6V 280Ah
item.description: The PowerRun 25.6V 280Ah LiFePO4 battery provides 7.17kWh of usable capacity for homes and small businesses that need more runtime than a standard 100-200Ah pack. An integrated Smart BMS manages charge and discharge protection, and the LiFePO4 chemistry is rated for 6000+ cycles at 80% depth of discharge, safe, stable and low-maintenance compared to lead-acid. Backed by a 5-year warranty.

item.title: PR LFP Battery 25.6V 550Ah
item.description: The PowerRun 25.6V 550Ah LiFePO4 battery is a high-capacity 14.08kWh energy storage solution for homes, small offices and solar systems with heavier daily loads. It combines an integrated Smart BMS with active cell balancing to keep every cell performing evenly over its 6000+ cycle life at 80% depth of discharge, resisting the capacity fade and maintenance headaches of lead-acid banks. Comes with a 5-year warranty.

item.title: PR LFP Battery 51.2V 100Ah

item.title: PR Solar Panel 450W
item.description: The PowerRun 450W Mono PERC Solar Panel uses high-efficiency monocrystalline PERC cells (up to 21.3% module efficiency) housed in an anodised aluminium frame with 3.2mm tempered anti-reflective glass. Rated to operate from -40C to 85C and built to handle real-world rooftop and ground-mount conditions, it is a dependable choice for residential and small commercial solar installations.
